summary: Reads TOP image data from a named shared-memory block created by another TouchDesigner process or a third-party application.

key_params.name: name
key_params.note: Shared memory block name to read from.

key_params.name: local
key_params.note: Use a unique local shared memory segment.

key_params.name: global
key_params.note: Use the combined global shared memory segment.

common_gotchas: Name and memory type must match the Shared Mem Out TOP or external writer.
Use Local for sharing with applications other than TouchDesigner.
Global memory can conflict because it is a combined segment shared by TouchDesigner nodes.
Shared-memory workflows still need matching resolution, format, and producer lifetime outside this node.
key_concepts: Shared Mem In reads image data from a named shared-memory block.
The writer can be another TouchDesigner process or a third-party application.
Local shared memory is required for non-TouchDesigner applications, while Global uses a combined segment across TouchDesigner nodes.
The reader must match the writer name, memory type, and practical data layout expectations.
